added.name: Nebula Security
added.long_description:
Nebula Security is an AI-native cybersecurity company founded by world-class hackers.

We were the first team to build an nginx RCE and the first to root Android 17 through a full browser-to-kernel exploit chain.

Nebula Security provides mythos-level code scanning and premium security auditing, covering everything from code-level vulnerabilities to architectural weak points.

“Audited by Nebula Security” is a mark of serious security credibility: a signal to customers, investors, and partners that your product has been reviewed by the world's best hackers.

long_description.before:
We’re a team of podcast fanatics with more than 20 years of combined experience in the audio space. We are building the fastest-growing podcast player and are now backed by YCombinator (W18).

At Podcast App, we are building an audio platform to help millions of people in their pursuit of happiness. Under one roof, we bring the best and most powerful podcasts, audiobooks, and meditations from leading minds and experts around the world.

Our love for podcasts began when we discovered their power to make our ordinary day-to-day tasks more enjoyable and meaningful. Podcasts helped transform tedious activities like commutes or household chores into more positive experiences, helping us learn new skills, stay informed, or pass the time with captivating stories. We want to help people in their pursuit of happiness.

We’ve been podcast aficionados for years, and, even for us, finding the right one to listen to is difficult and frustrating. With tens of millions to choose from and more being released every day, the problem’s only getting worse.

It’s time to fix this problem. Americans spend 30 billion hours every year commuting and doing household chores. We want to make those hours worthwhile. By building technology that makes it easy to access great podcasts, we’ll help millions of people reclaim lost time and experience more fun, inspiration, and personal growth every day.

Our product, Podcast App, is a minimalist podcast player enhanced with cutting-edge technology. We leverage machine learning to build customized podcast playlists for our users based on their interests and tastes.

If you want to get in touch, email us at hello@podcast.app.
long_description.after:
Evolve builds consumer apps used by millions. We're a YC W18 company with two products.

Rest (getrest.app) is an AI sleep coach for people tired of bad nights, whether that's lying awake for hours or waking up at 3am. It's built on the principles of CBT-I (cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia), the method sleep clinicians recommend first, and turns them into a daily program with a coach you can talk to at any hour. No appointments, no waitlists. People use it to sleep well again without leaning on melatonin, sleep aids, or 2am doom-scrolling. Users often go from years of broken sleep to sleeping through the night in weeks. We build Rest with sleep scientists and behavior-design experts.

Podcast App is one of the largest independent podcast players: a minimalist app with tens of millions of downloads that uses machine learning to build playlists around what you like.

Our team has built consumer products with 100M+ installs, and our work has been featured by Apple, TechCrunch, Yahoo, Fast Company, and Fox. Get in touch: hello@getrest.app.

one_liner.before: Podcast App is for the curious.
one_liner.after: Rest is an AI sleep coach that helps you fix your sleep for good,…

long_description.before:
Flux Auto is building autonomous mobility technology to fully automate the movement and operation of vehicles in controlled spaces. Using Flux's solutions customers can reduce their dependency on human drivers, while also increasing productivity and reducing operating costs. 

Flux is currently deploying in warehouses, farms and mines.
long_description.after:
Flux is building physical AI to automate material movement in warehouses and factories on legacy vehicle fleets. Using Flux's solutions customers can reduce their dependency on human drivers, while also increasing productivity and reducing operating costs. 

Flux is currently deploying with customers like Walmart, Daimler, Bajaj, Cummins, Mahindra Logistics across warehouses, fulfillment centers and factories.

one_liner.after: Physical AI for Warehouses and Factories

long_description.before: Arc empowers startups with a better banking experience. With Arc, you can store deposits,  schedule and manage payments, diversify cash across asset classes, and access non-dilutive financing all in one place. Arc is based in San Francisco and is funded by Left Lane Capital, NFX, Bain Capital Ventures, Clocktower Technology Ventures, Torch Capital, and Y Combinator, among others. To learn more, visit www.arc.tech.
long_description.after:
Arc is the cash management and capital markets platform for technology companies. Arc helps businesses manage cash, unlock competitive yield, raise debt capital, and access AI-powered financial services – all in one unified platform.

Founded in 2021, Arc has headquarters in San Francisco and New York City and is backed by investors including Left Lane Capital, NFX, Bain Capital Ventures, Atalaya, Clocktower Technology Ventures, Torch Capital, and Y Combinator. To learn more, visit www.joinarc.com.

Arc is a financial technology company, not a bank. For important information about Arc, see our general disclosures: https://www.joinarc.com/general-disclosures

long_description.before: Kaso (formerly Elkaso) is the largest B2B ordering platform for restaurants and suppliers in the Middle East. Kaso connects restaurants and suppliers, to manage and improve the order process end to end to save time, money, and food.
long_description.after:
Independent restaurants pay ~12% more than chains for the exact same food supplies because they buy alone.
Kaso uses AI agents to aggregate purchasing demand from restaurants and negotiate chain-level pricing with suppliers.

one_liner.before: B2B platform connecting restaurants with food suppliers

long_description.before: WithIda is an AI teammate for founders and small teams. Tell Ida what to handle — outreach, follow-ups, competitor monitoring, morning briefings — and she executes across your connected tools. She starts supervised and earns autonomy over time. You’re delegating, not abdicating.
long_description.after: Companies are connecting AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude directly to their databases — where one wrong command can delete data or leak customer records. Midplane sits in between and controls what each agent is allowed to do: it blocks dangerous queries, hides sensitive data, and keeps a record of everything the agent touches. It’s open source, and runs either as a hosted service or on your own servers.

one_liner.before: AI that works across your tools and earns the right to run solo
one_liner.after: The safety layer between AI agents and your database

long_description.after: Deterministic, auditable automation for the finance workflows your team dreads. We build and run it on your existing stack. You approve only the exceptions.

long_description.before:
SEO & GEO is confusing and massively overpriced. RankAI will handle everything autonomously to drive you millions of visitors from Google and AI search like ChatGPT. 

RankAI first identifies search queries your customers already search for, then it builds search-optimized pages to capture millions of these queries. Finally, like a real agency, RankAI will track its results, rethink its strategy, and rewrite pages again and again to improve performance. RankAI does not stop until traffic swarms in.
long_description.after:
Websites used to be static billboards, passive and waiting to be found.  

RankAI helps startups and agencies grow websites autonomously. It learns from your site, market, competitors, and performance data to identify which pages should exist, creates them in your brand, publishes them directly to your live website, and continuously improves them based on real traffic and conversion — so your website gets discovered, trusted, and converted on by both human and Agents.

one_liner.before: AI-Native Agency for Organic Growth (SEO & GEO)
AI Agents for outbound working by your side
one_liner.after: All-in-one AI platform  for outbound sales

long_description.before: Freesolo works with companies to encode user-trajectory knowledge into specialized models that outperform the state of the art at much lower latency and cost.
long_description.after: Clado builds global people search to help discover the best leads, recruits, and POCs for your business

long_description.before:
Fresh-produce supply chains are built around guesswork. Growers plant without clear demand signals, distributors overbuy to protect against shortages, and retailers end up eating the waste. GETASAP fixes this by rebuilding distribution around real demand and fast execution. We deliver wholesale fresh produce with 8-hour same-day delivery, using micro-fulfillment centers positioned close to demand so we can operate with far less safety stock.

Behind the scenes, we look at live retail sales, purchasing, and waste patterns to decide what to source, where to place inventory, and when to replenish. That lets us buy closer to actual demand, turn inventory faster, and materially reduce spoilage. For retailers, GETASAP replaces procurement teams and fragmented supplier management—we handle sourcing, inventory decisions, and fulfillment end to end as a single, reliable partner. As more volume flows through the network, demand becomes clearer, sourcing gets smarter, and the operation becomes cheaper and more predictable over time.
long_description.after:
Founded in 2023, GETASAP is a San Francisco–based technology and supply chain infrastructure company transforming fresh produce distribution and freight.

GETASAP provides same-day delivery to thousands of restaurants and retail locations across the USA, sourcing directly from farms internationally. It operates GETASAP Logistics, an AI-native freight carrier and brokerage, to deliver reliable reefer LTL and FTL services powered by VoiceAI dispatch, optimized scheduling, and real-time operational intelligence.

Main Offices: 
Mountain View, CA (HQ)
Fresno, CA
Alpharetta, GA

long_description.before:
Parametric builds autonomous physical businesses.

We're starting with a laundromat, designed from the ground up for autonomy. Dirty laundry in, folded clean laundry out.

Rather than retrofit human workflows with robots, we redesign processes with robots as first class citizens.

VibeFlow generates full-stack web apps from prompts with n8n-style visual workflows for the backend. Users of tools like Lovable or v0 can easily iterate over frontends because they can see them, while backends remain closed black boxes that are hard to evolve through prompting. VibeFlow opens up backend logic, making it visual and editable, with powerful integrations built in.
long_description.after: VibeFlow is the AI content manager for startups. Anyone can build a company in a weekend now, but nobody knows how to distribute it. Existing AI tools spit out generic, off-brand content you can't really use. VibeFlow learns your brand, voice, and goals, then autonomously creates on-brand, tailored posts (with visuals) ready to publish. VibeFlow is the AI growth engine that turns ideas into distribution.

one_liner.before: Lovable, n8n and a database all in one platform
one_liner.after: AI content manager that grows your company's online presence

long_description.before:
LunaBill is building AI Voice callers for healthcare billing teams. Insurance claim follow-up calls account for the 80% of the daily workload of a healthcare billing team, with each call averaging 30 minutes.

Since our launch in July we are now at $764K in contracted ARR, of which $428K is live revenue and the rest will go live by January 2026. Our customers see a 10x increase in claims followed up per biller in the first week and we have converted 100% of pilots to paying customers. We have automated 50,000+ calls and signed partnerships with top healthcare leaders like UC health systems, Mayo, Experian Health and more.

The founders have known each other for over a year. Suhail is a 2x founder, with 3+ years of experience building in healthcare including operating a medical billing company with 200+ healthcare clients. David founded Skiesoft, Taiwan’s biggest healthcare AI scribe company, used by 120k+ healthcare professionals. He also worked as a data scientist at UCSF, building models to audit medical-coding accuracy. Yash was a researcher at various hospital systems including Mayo Clinic.
